calculation_policy: No parcel elevation statistics are computed here. Only official DEM/LIDAR tile/index evidence may be accepted after verified canonical BUILDING_PRESENT binding; local OpenCode performs spatial join and min/max/mean/max-min.
first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel identifier/geometry or exact missing DEM/LIDAR tile selector from local OpenCode; without that binding no DTM tile feature can be accepted for this slot
next_modified_method: Use the local OpenCode BUILDING_PRESENT missing-tile selector to issue a bounded (<=50) polygon/intersection query against an unused official Environment Agency DTM tile-index window; retain exact filename/os_ref/polygon_id, EPSG:27700, capture dates and source resolution, and leave min/max/mean/max-min calculation local.

source_window.record_acceptance_reason: The slot has no verified canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel id/geometry or exact missing tile selector. Layer metadata establishes the official tile-index schema and access path but does not identify the missing tile for a canonical parcel.
source_window.source_file_sha256_status: REMOTE_LAYER_HTML_BYTES_NOT_EXPORTED_BY_WEB_RETRIEVAL; generated source_evidence.json has its own verified SHA-256 sidecar
source_window.source_window_type: ArcGIS REST Feature Layer metadata data endpoint
source_window.tile_packaging: GeoTIFF raster data in 5km zipfiles aligned to OS Grid
